title: llm-ui-coord-benchmark belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: lydiaaam/llm-ui-coord-benchmark. A comprehensive benchmark suite for evaluating LLM reasoning on UI coordinate tasks. It has about 79 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.
